# Weapon position data for creating effects in 1st person

Source: [wiki article 9331](../archive/9331.md); edited 2026-07-18.

<a id="wiki-9331-n1"></a>

- Weapon offsets measured at FOV 103 while heroes idle; dual wield records right gun. Source explicitly excludes third person and weapon animations.

<a id="wiki-9331-n2"></a>

- Formula is eye position + facing direction + world-right*xoff + normalized cross(facing,world-right)*yoff, wrapped in Update Every Frame.

<a id="wiki-9331-n3"></a>

- Anchor notes specify Hanzo arrow tip, Zenyatta behind interlaced fingers, Roadhog between barrels, Doomfist left hand, Lifeweaver finger/palm and Juno muzzle.

<a id="wiki-9331-n4"></a>

- Calibration mode A87YG and native snippet: Melee switches X/Y axis; primary/secondary adjust negative/positive; Interact changes step .1 to .01; emote toggles fixed third-person camera; death cycles hero.

<a id="wiki-9331-n5"></a>

- Table/JSON disagree: Mercy staff x=.12 vs .08; JSON includes Sojourn missing in table; table includes Illari missing in JSON.

<a id="wiki-9331-n6"></a>

- Source examples are not ready to paste: the JSON omits commas near its end and the collection snippet lacks an End. Rebuild examples from the normalized measurements before compilation.
